description:
The contract a calling agent sees.

The status field is the reason this type exists: a caller can tell "this member does not
exist" from "the automation broke" without parsing a message string.

status.description: success: the flow completed and outputs are present. business_outcome: a declared business situation occurred and is described in outcome. failure: the automation could not complete, described in failure.
status.title: Status

outputs.description: Declared outputs, present on success and possibly partial on a business outcome.
outputs.title: Outputs

outcome.description: The outcome that fired, when one did.

failure.description: Debuggable detail, present only when status is failure.
